environment.hardware: MacBook Pro Mac17,6, Apple M5 Max, 128 GB

sampling.scenarios: Run every Phase 1A scenario on every representative document; report each distribution separately without pooling documents.

t_event.definition: Browser beforeinput timestamp; trace origin, not physical-input time.

t_echo.definition: Elapsed time from t_event to the exact speculative DOM checkpoint.

t_dispatch.definition: Elapsed time from t_event until the edit transaction is dispatched to the authority actor.

t_ack.definition: Elapsed time from t_event until the authority actor acknowledges the transaction.

t_reconcile.definition: Elapsed time from t_event until authoritative reconciliation completes.

t_present.definition: Elapsed time from t_event through Electron WebContents.capturePage with stayHidden and stayAwake after the exact acknowledged view checkpoint in the transparent, render-active, inactive macOS measurement window, followed by immediate retained-state validation; a captured compositor-surface upper bound, not proof of pixel equality, physical display, vsync, or next-frame time.

open.definition: Elapsed time from the open request until the authoritative document session is accepted.

first_viewport.definition: Elapsed time from the open request until the first viewport is editable.
